pages.title: 3D is here
pages.text: Press 3D on the map and the imagery stands on its relief. Tilt, turn and fly down into any valley.

pages.label: Drawing tools
pages.title: Create your own map!
pages.text: Draw markers, lines and areas with your own icons, every change dated, then send it to My Maps or a KMZ.

pages.title: Maps ready to publish
pages.text: Start from a ready plate, set its look, and export an image, a PDF or a video of its days.

pages.label: View · Overlay · Find
pages.title: Horizon
pages.text: Stand on any point and see its skyline. Find looks for the places that see the ridges of a photo.

pages.title: And also

items.text: Measure turns a line into range rings, a view cone or a line of sight.
Reference windows fade and play clips over the map.
Media opens in one full-screen viewer.

pages.help: The guide now shows every tool in pictures, and walks a geolocation step by step.
